pages.text: Only a Maw that has swallowed every Mutation, borne by a hunter who has taken in all four other gifts, may sprout the final organ. A silent antenna unfurls, and the world's creatures stray from your path as from a thing they cannot name.
No creature will begin a fight with you. But strike one, and the spell breaks for that creature alone. The great Bosses, the Elder Guardian and the raiders are deaf to the antenna.

Deed (Excelsior): bear a Maw with all fourteen Mutations, having earned every other Assimilation. Commune with the beast (Shift + Right Click) to still or awaken the antenna. The gift sleeps unless a Maw of the Excelsior Stage is carried.
